'''IP17''' was the author of a message published<ref name="ADC">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20020411acult&c=swlfc|text=A Dark Cult}}</ref> in around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the initial setting of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The publication of IP17's message can therefore be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> that highlighted the emergence of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]]. The message written by IP17 was briefly published on every newsboard in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was in a format consistent with transmissions sent to the [[Almas Academy]] [[Jedi academy|Jedi training institution]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. This led some people in the Cularin system to suspect that IP17 was an [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] envoy who had prepared the message for the attention of the Academy's staff. Others theorized that the message was authored by the Believers themselves to scare the Cularin people.<ref name="ADC" />
